entities.summary: Mstino is a lake in Tver Oblast, Russia, in the Valdai Hills area. Its main outflow is Msta River. The lake occupies an area of 13.7 square kilometres (5.3 mi2), its length is 13.8 kilometres (8.6 mi), and its maximum width 1.8 kilometres (1.1 mi). It lies at an altitude of 154 meters, with maximum depth of 10 meters.
